subject: SOC 2 evidence: personnel onboarding & offboarding controls (training, BG, deprovisioning)
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@apexaudit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 request: personnel controls evidence needed

Hi Mina,

We are preparing the personnel controls section for Redwood Inference's SOC 2 assessment. To complete our review we need the following artifacts related to employee onboarding/offboarding and training: 

- Training completion logs (last 12 months) with course IDs and completion timestamps.
- Background check vendor attestation and a redacted sample of background check reports.
- Standard onboarding checklist/template used for new hires.
- Deprovisioning/offboarding timeline for users (SSO, GSuite, source control) for the last 12 months.

Can you confirm you can provide these by EOW (Nov 19)? If any of the items will take longer, please indicate ETA and whether a redacted sample is acceptable in advance of full exports.

Also let us know your preferred delivery method (secure file share, DocuSign, or Drive link) and whether you'll be including a short cover note explaining redaction approach.

Thanks,

Sara Lopez
Senior SOC Auditor
Apex Audit
sara.lopez@apexaudit.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@apexaudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request: personnel controls evidence needed

Hi Sara,

Thanks for the list — we can provide these. Quick notes:

- Training completion logs: will provide CSV export (course ID, user ID, completion timestamp, certificate id where applicable).
- Background checks: security/HR will prepare redacted PDFs and vendor attestation letter.
- Onboarding checklist: we will include our standard template used across engineering and product hires.
- Deprovisioning timeline: security will export SSO and access logs; we'll include a short narrative explaining the deprovisioning workflow.

Delivery: secure Drive link is easiest; if you require an alternate method let me know. We will include a short cover note that explains what fields were redacted and why.

Target: initial bundle by Nov 18 COB (one day earlier than your EOW request). If anything slips we will notify you immediately.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: FW: SOC 2 request: personnel controls evidence needed

Marissa / Soojin — forwarding auditor request from Apex. Need us to assemble the bundle. Please confirm below items and ETA: 

Marissa (HR):
- Export training completion CSV for last 12 months (include course ID, user email, completion timestamp).
- Produce redacted sample of background checks (5 samples) and vendor attestation letter.
- Include onboarding checklist template (PDF).

Soojin (Security):
- Export deprovisioning/offboarding evidence: SSO deprovision logs, pull request of deprovision tickets, and a short narrative of the deprovision workflow (who triggers, timelines, verification).
- Provide leaver-deprovision-log for 2026-2027 as CSV.

Also: please prepare a manifest.csv listing each file, the sensitive fields redacted, and who approved the redaction. Auditor expects that.

Deadline: Nov 18 COB. If either of you foresee blockers (legal redaction requirements, PII handling), call me ASAP — we can request a short extension from Sara but prefer to meet date.

Thanks — Mina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@apexaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: SOC 2 request: personnel controls evidence needed

Hi team,

Attached export bundle (redacted where noted) and Drive link below. Summary of attachments included in the shared folder: 

- training-completion-2027Q3.csv (course_id, user_email, completion_ts, cert_id)
- background-checks-redacted.pdf (PII redacted: SSNs, DOBs; names retained with employee IDs)
- vendor-attestation-acmebg-2027.pdf (vendor signed attestation)

- leaver-deprovision-log-2026-2027.csv (username, deprovision_ts, ticket_id, services_removed)
- manifest.csv (file list with redaction notes and approver signatures)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExampleDriveLink
Delivery method: secure Drive folder with restricted share to Apex Audit account. Please confirm receipt and let us know if you need PII further redacted or additional context.

Marissa Cole
Senior HR Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
